sentences.en: It is important for you to learn a foreign language.
sentences.zh: 你学习一门外语是很重要的。

sentences.en: Effectively dealing with competition is an important part of life.
sentences.zh: 有效应对竞争是生活中很重要的一部分。

sentences.en: The chairman put forward an important plan at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 会上主席提出了一项重要计划。

senses.zh: 重要的，重大的；  importance n .重要性； importantly

collocations.en: be of great importance to sb./sth
